reviews.review: I have no ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ clue how to play this game.

Great once you are established, id say about 20-30 hrs in but just starting out can be frustrating and confusing if solo or with an inexperienced group. for the best experience id say make friends in chat and get sherpa'd

I want to get off [strike]Mr. Bones'[/strike]Digital Extreme's Wild Ride.

In all seriousness, this game is good. Playing as a Space Ninja is fun, the Devs are cool (and actually care about their players), the community is pretty nice (usually, but what community isn't without its rotten apples?), and there is nothing else like it that I know of. But remember: [b]MMOs are highly addictive.[/b] This is by design. However, this game is by far the least scummy/leechy/manipulative MMO I've ever encountered (not that it is completely without its moments), but it will absolutely chew through your time regardless of whether you throw money at it or not.

And it cares not about if you had plans for your day, because it is constantly loaded with IRL time limited event-type stuff that go on regardless of your online status. You wanted to sleep? Too bad about those upgrades you wanted that showed up as rewards for that overnight invasion then. You wanted to have llunch? Well, you just missed a chance to get some of those materials from the Day/Night cycle areas that go by IRL time, next cycle starts in an hour, hope you like that. You wanted to have a weekend off away from this game? Oops, Baro's here, hope you planned around that. (There's a clock that says when he shows up next, in fact. Just FYI.) And so on. This game cares not about your schedule.

I'd give you a description of what this game is actually like, but honestly there's a ton of media out there that does a better job than I could ever do. There's even a very well maintained wiki. Just know that Space Ninja controls similar but different to any other FPS you've every played. Also that the Space Ninja designs are a lot unlike the designs for any other character you've ever controls. Very artsy, in a good way.

So, while I do recommend it, I [u]only[/u] recommend it to people who [u]KNOW[/u] they like/love MMOs and who have complete control over their lives (instead of, idk, havng to randomly & frequently help family or go fight a fire or something) and won't regret spending thousands of hours on this game instead of doing anything else. Otherwise, just watch other people play it. There's lots of streamers streaming this game these days.

And if you do play it, remember to take breaks every hour or so, okay?
